art_direction: 单颗沙金环行星悬在靛蓝宇宙中，环面斜穿主体，星点极少。
composition: one original focal subject, centered and readable within a circular avatar crop
creative_direction: Show a single muted sand-gold planet with a broad thin ring tilted diagonally across its lower half. Place it centrally against a deep indigo field, leaving ample space around the ring. Use a soft terminator shadow to define the sphere, with only two broad cloud bands on its surface. Add a few distant stars of different brightness, not a dense glitter pattern. Keep the ring translucent at its far edge and gently lit near the foreground, with no spacecraft or extra planets. Create a square 1024x1024 avatar with a clear central silhouette that remains legible at thumbnail size. Use an original text-only composition, without lettering, logos, signatures, or watermarks.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for clear original focal composition, requested medium and detail level, circular-crop readability, no unintended anatomy or rendering defects, no text or watermark
